requirement.description: Missing handling for parameters that are not provided with values in _map_function_annotations function. Several tests fail with "Parameter X was not given a value" errors because the function doesn't properly handle missing parameter values.
requirement.contract: When a function parameter has no corresponding input value in template_inputs, the function should either skip that parameter (if it has a default), or properly raise an informative error. The current implementation attempts to process all parameters regardless of whether they have values.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of directory creation in _run function. Tests fail with "IsADirectoryError: [Errno 21] Is a directory" errors when trying to write output files to directory paths instead of file paths.
requirement.contract: When the output path resolves to a directory, the system should create an output file within that directory instead of attempting to write directly to the directory path. The function should ensure that output paths are treated as files, not directories.

requirement.description: Improper handling of artifact loading when artifact files don't exist. Some tests fail with FileNotFoundError when artifact files are not found, instead of handling gracefully.
requirement.contract: When loading artifacts from files that don't exist, the system should return sensible defaults instead of crashing. Specifically, for JSON artifacts, it should return None, and for file artifacts, it should return an empty string.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of type validation for annotated outputs. When saving outputs, the system fails to properly validate that output values match their expected types.
requirement.contract: When saving annotated outputs, the system should validate that output values match their expected types. If types don't match, it should attempt conversion or raise a clear error message.

requirement.description: Missing support for kebab-case to snake_case parameter name conversion in function parameter mapping.
requirement.contract: Function parameters that use kebab-case naming convention (like "a-but-kebab") should be properly mapped to snake_case parameters (like "a_but_kebab") when looking up values in template_inputs. The current implementation has incomplete conversion logic.
